sections.heading: Section 7
paragraphs: In India, a provisional patent application is a temporary measure that allows the applicant to secure interim protection prior to filing a full patent application. It is not subject to the formal patent claims like a regular file provisional patent online India.

A provisional patent service in India is a sort of notice to those in charge that a new invention has been created and who owns it. It offers temporary protection. It’s smart to file it online to get an earlier date. You then have to submit the real patent within 1 year. In this manner, your invention remains protected even if somebody else attempts to patent the same item down the road.
What To Keep In Mind When You Fill Out A Provisional Patent:
Complete Description of the Invention:

The provisional patent must describe the invention clearly and in detail. You have one year from the date you submit your provisional application to file a comprehensive description of your invention. Before filing a provisional patent application in India, a priority application form, disclose any important information you have about the invention. This might be the only time you can do this without repercussions.
Avoid Overlooking Prior Art :

Before filing your provisional patent, you must conduct a patent search or review relevant prior art (existing patents or published materials). It helps you determine the novelty of your invention and to confirm that you are not infringing on someone else’s patents.
Comprise All Aspects of the Invention:
The patent application should articulate the boundaries of the invention; don't tack on new features later after filing the patent service in India.

Provisional patent applications expire after 12 months from their filing date and are not extendable. You must then file a non-provisional patent application within this time frame in order to obtain the benefit of the provisional filing date.
Work with a patent attorney:

Although you can file your own provisional patent application, collaboration with a patent attorney or agent will help to maximize the chances of your application being strong. Services Plus, being a filing provisional patent online in India can help make certain that your written description and drawings meet the requisite legal standard, which can potentially assist down the line in your efforts to file a non-provisional patent.
Privacy and Disclosure:

If your invention is not yet filed and you want to explain it to others, be smart. In some jurisdictions, displaying your invention publicly (both sharing it with investors and demonstrating it at any trade shows) can jeopardize your ability to patent it. But the provisional patent in India can give you a priority date that could save you from being a victim in these cases.

At what point in the process can an applicant file a provisional patent online?
An applicant can file a provisional patent while their invention is still in the testing stage. This helps establish the invention's priority date.
How long is a provisional patent application valid?
A provisional patent application is valid for one year. To benefit from filing a Provisional Patent application, the applicant should provide all detailed specifications along with the filing date.
Can you sell a provisional patent?
Yes, an applicant can grant a license to a third party for the rights outlined in their provisional patent application.
What three types of patents are there?

There are three types of patents: utility, design, and plant patents. A utility patent can be granted to anyone who creates a new, useful method, apparatus, manufactured article, composition of matter, or any new, helpful improvement there of.
Can I independently submit a provisional patent?
Yes, many provisional patent applications can be submitted by innovators without the need for an attorney, as they don't require a claim.
